document: Race dates for editions the weather evidence has no row for, reviewed by hand and cited (2026-11-05; 2026-11-14 for the combined release). Every builder that orders a runner’s linked finishes by race date reads this file after the weather evidence; a date here never changes a weather figure, because the edition still has no weather row. `city` is the edition’s label as the pipeline writes it; `release_city`, where given, is the release’s own key. An entry with `weekday` was accepted only because its date falls on that weekday, which analysis/adapt_combined.py checks again; an edition with no recorded evidence of its date has no entry and stays undated.
